description: Composite primary keys in a WITHOUT ROWID table remain usable after additive evolution.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE settings (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,key)) WITHOUT ROWID;
migration_sql: ALTER TABLE settings ADD COLUMN revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;

checks.name: composite_rows
checks.sql: SELECT tenant,key,value,revision FROM settings ORDER BY tenant,key

checks.name: composite_key
checks.sql: SELECT name,pk FROM pragma_table_info('settings') WHERE pk>0 ORDER BY pk

checks.name: without_rowid_preserved
checks.sql: SELECT instr(upper(sql),'WITHOUT ROWID')>0 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='settings'
